name: Vermillion (United States)
description: White field with a large red script V, over wavy stripes of green and blue along the bottom for the prairie and the Missouri River.
history: Vermillion is a city in and the county seat of Clay County. The flag was adopted in 2009 (the city's first flag, a combination of designs by Jane and Elen O'Brien chosen in a six-month contest held in 2008, was approved by the city council in February 2009 for dedication at the new city hall on 30 April 2009, according to Flags of the World citing The Volante).
